# Synthetic inputs

`knowledge/operating_rules.md` contains invented rules for R1, R2 and R3.
The compatibility configurations `experiments/synthetic_llm.yaml` and
`experiments/synthetic_cascade.yaml` use it to demonstrate passing local text
to an agent. It is not F.E. Walter guidance or a validated operating policy.

For the maintained configuration tutorial, start with
[`templates/coupled`](../../../templates/coupled/README.md).
